mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) signals an accommodative policy environment, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline for 20 trading days, or returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) signals an accommodative policy environment, compressing discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline for 5 trading days, or returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) over the next 60 trading days signals a sustained accommodative stance, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline for 60 trading days, or returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE (unemployment) above 6.0% signals weakening labor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE does not rise above 6.0% for the next month, or 20d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime, a sustained increase in UNRATE (unemployment) signals weakening labor demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE ≤ 5.8% or FEDFUNDS ≥ 2.0% (indicating non-recessionary conditions), or 20d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals supply-side contraction, reducing corporate earnings and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO remains above 100 for the next month, or 20d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS (monetary easing) and rise in GDPC1 (demand growth) creates a dual signal of accommodative policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the combination of FEDFUNDS ≥ 2.0 or GDPC1 ≤ 11700, or 60d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals supply-side contraction, reducing corporate earnings and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If either INDPRO ≥ 100 or HOUST ≥ 1066, or 20d returns are not significantly negative (p>0.05).
